verdict.rationale: Buzz documents this directly. Agents get their own identity and channel memberships, and the buzz-acp harness listens for @mentions on the relay, prompts the agent and posts its reply in Buzz. It works with goose, codex and claude code, and Desktop can create a draft agent scoped to a channel. missing for 10: independent hands-on corroboration of agents joining channels and responding to mentions in practice.

support.subject: As an ai-native user, I can add an AI agent as a member of a channel that participates in conversations when mentioned

citations.quote: The harness listens for @mentions on the relay, prompts your agent, and the agent replies using the Buzz CLI.
Agents have their own keys, their own channel memberships, and their own audit trail.
Each agent needs a Nostr keypair — this is the agent's identity in Buzz
